title: herdr-ticks plugin scaffold: manifest, dev install, first action
description: Layer 3 foundation. Create plugins/herdr-ticks/ with herdr-plugin.toml (name, min_herdr_version 0.8.0, platforms) wired for: one pane entry (placeholder command for now), one working action ("Open tick board" running tk board or printing a URL), and the event-hook declaration shape (commands added by later ticks). Dev flow: herdr plugin link <path>; document install (herdr plugin install pengelbrecht/ticks/plugins/herdr-ticks once merged). Verify live: plugin link, plugin list shows it, action invokable. Study the installed example manifests via herdr plugin list --json for the real schema; do not guess fields.
acceptance_criteria: herdr plugin link succeeds live; plugin list --json shows manifest with pane+action+events sections; the action runs; unlink clean
